held_out.text: TASK-29 implements one explicit English text-to-speech profile. It uses the actual SpeechT5 pretrained weights, character/audio processor, published demo speaker-conditioning vector and HiFi-GAN vocoder. It trains only the mel and stop output heads (124,578 of 144,431,684 TTS parameters), with FP32 AdamW on one cooperating CPU thread. Model output is an actual PCM16 WAV. Registry labels, metadata-only training and empty files cannot establish a successful result.

Application feedback imports authorized, versioned development observations into the existing Annotation review and dataset publication flow. It neither polls applications nor enables telemetry. Collection is disabled by default in every project. Even after enabling collection, an event is metadata only unless the administrator enables content and its caller explicitly attests consent for that event.

The [23 October current recipe qualification](verification/task77-gpu-recipes-2026-10-23/report.md) executes three-step MPS full-SFT/LoRA and native MLX four-bit adapter updates, exact recovery and independent held-out scoring on the pinned current dependencies. Full-SFT/LoRA pass the bounded loss check. QLoRA execution passes while its quality comparison against the unquantized base fails. The report records exact per-run source builds and browser previews; other hardware and production remain unqualified.

Create an account on a self-service-enabled installation to provision a workspace, team and first project. The owner opens Overview → Team access, enters the reviewer's email and shares the one-time code privately. The invitee chooses **Have an invitation code?** on the welcome screen, supplies the matching email, name and new password, then joins. A code expires after 72 hours, works once and is shown only when issued. Pending invitations can be revoked and replaced. No email delivery is sent by this flow.

Customer quality, production release, human listening, speaker identity/fidelity, customer voices, product ASR, voice cloning, other languages/models and GPU/distributed execution require separate qualification. The small automatic test below is an intelligibility proxy, not a customer acceptance result.

The profile permits 1–20 updates, 1–32 reviewed pairs per split, and 128 tokens per sequence without truncation. RLOO samples 2–4 fresh completions of at most eight tokens for one prompt per update. It does not append an EOS that was not sampled. Reward training includes the tokenizer's EOS in each labelled response. Control tokens and unstable prompt boundaries are refused. Older character examples and PPO records remain separate reference paths.

The [final branch inventory](verification/task61-final-integration-2026-10-23/branches.json) includes **94 local and remote refs**, including remote-only branches. [Six worktree registrations](verification/task61-final-integration-2026-10-23/worktrees.json) include the original dirty feature-parity checkout and the stale recipes-verification registration. The active inventory branch is observed before this documentation commit; its final PR/head and merge evidence are recorded separately with

A workspace supports one non-owner teammate or pending invitation. Reviewers can inspect its projects and evidence, submit or escalate labels and record an evaluation decision. They cannot launch jobs, publish batches, change memberships or deploy models. Owners manage invitations and can remove the teammate in Team access. Removal immediately invalidates existing browser and personal API credentials for the workspace. Service credentials without a user remain separate operator-managed credentials.

In Annotation, open **Private application feedback → Feedback collection and retention** as an organization administrator. Enable collection and choose retention within the project's Privacy limit. Content collection has a separate opt-in. Shortening either retention setting also shortens existing receipts; increasing it never extends them. The effective default is the project's measurement retention period, normally 30 days.

Denials return a generic unresolvable relationship validation error (400), inaccessible resource lookup (404), or insufficient role (403). They must not surface ORM exceptions. API-level tests cover two tenants/two restricted projects, legitimate scoped writes, explicit sharing, related writes and selected custom actions. Training regressions add POST/PUT/PATCH relationship denial, ownership/null override denial, inaccessible run/action lookup, viewer denial and principal-scoped idempotency. Release tests cover role/reference denial and runtime-unqualified promotion; a manager role alone is not serving qualification.

RLOO freezes that learned head and the starting reference. Fresh full-vocabulary multinomial samples receive learned reward minus beta times the sampled policy/reference log ratio. Each sample's baseline is the mean reward of the other samples for the same prompt. A single on-policy sequence REINFORCE update uses these detached, unstandardized advantages. This follows [Ahmadian et al., section 2.3](https://arxiv.org/html/2402.14740v1). Stale rollouts cannot be reused after a policy change. Post-update categorical KL at sampled contexts

Compute requests use organization scope even when a project is selected in the workspace. The browser's task jobs retain the selected project. A key intrinsically restricted to a project remains restricted and cannot provision or release organization compute.

Local test evidence is recorded in [status](status.md). Concurrency, external storage, production identity providers and full operational penetration review are outside this local verification. TASK-4 must establish concurrent idempotent dispatch, durable outbox/accounting and worker execution; TASK-5 must establish changed-resource launch revalidation.

Only adapter parameters change. Downloads contain Safetensors/PEFT adapter files and exact base provenance; acquire the pinned base separately. Verified policy candidates use existing bounded local inference. Reward heads are scoring models and are excluded from chat and SFT base selection.

Attach one file up to 1 MiB at a time. Embedded-text PDF uses the pinned bounded pypdf child process; DOCX reads only its main-body paragraphs without following relationships or extracting archive paths. UTF-8 text and code are indexed as text and never executed. Source-byte hashes, extractor revisions and page/paragraph locations are preserved alongside reconstructed-text character spans. An attachment allows at most 256 location records and 32 KiB of location metadata; larger documents are refused whole. At most 50 source revisions and 2 MB of active source text enter

Training, RAG indexes, context recipes, and releases currently load the first registry page. Worker registration/execution retains its operator entry point. Document indexing and recipe block creation have browser authoring controls; production deployment promotion and rollback remain gated.

Identical application/event retries return the existing receipt and create no duplicate review task. The receipt freezes request identity, source/group identity, original model version, authorization/consent principal and expiry. Content is stored only in its owned review task, never audit snapshots or diagnostic output. Feedback lists do not echo prompt/prediction content. No hosted judge, external analytics or automatic generation is invoked.
Acquire the immutable model explicitly before registering it. With the optional environment installed:

Numerical scope is FP32 rank-eight q/v LoRA on the text decoder: 460,800 trainable parameters, frozen vision encoder/connector/base, AdamW at 0.00002, clipping at 1, initialization seed 42 and 1–20 updates. The pinned PIL Idefics3 processor disables image splitting and uses one 512px tile / 64 image tokens. Combined sequences fit within 128 tokens without truncation; labels cover only the native assistant response, including its end marker. Validation
Backend fixture tests and domain methods are not proof of a completed UI journey. The following planned features remain incomplete:

The original RAG infrastructure now has separate merged migrations, real embeddings, SQL retrieval, context/generation and report scopes. The original migration numbering was not copied over newer migrations. Local databases, artifacts, raw run directories, model weights and credentials remain outside these documentation commits.

Each committed update stores real loss, gradient/change counts, image SHA, CPU/wall measurements, device residency and available process memory observations. Checkpoints pin the base, processor, image assets, sample order, adapter and Adam moments. Automatic lease retry reloads the latest fenced checkpoint; stale attempts cannot publish. Cancellation discards unpublished updates. Accounting uses committed optimizer updates, including when an uncommitted update ran before cancellation or lease loss; it does not claim to meter elapsed compute. Terminal self-service recovery remains limited to the existing CPU reference runtimes.
QLoRA stays unsupported until a candidate passes the existing unquantized comparison. The native four-bit candidate already failed that gate.

A consented failure opens one project-scoped text-response Annotation campaign and one review task with its original prediction/model version intact. **Review application correction** opens that task. Reviewers use the ordinary independent review, conflict detection, adjudication and immutable batch snapshot path. Accepting the failed prediction unchanged is unavailable: only an independently supplied correction can enter training. Rejected/skipped records are excluded.

Supply canonical sample-envelope text JSONL from your own prepared data. Each row needs a unique sample identifier and source group, text blocks and provenance. Registration publishes protected train/validation/test splits. The command performs no download or training:

Each stage records declared upper resource bounds before computing. Checkpoints preserve weights, Adam moments, phase, update cursor, rollout scores, reference logits and CPU sampling RNG. Training, rollout and scoring have distinct reservations, including capacity for at most three attempts. Measured committed or aborted stages settle measured units. Interrupted work without a valid measurement stays explicitly unknown and charges its declared upper bound. Settlement releases unused capacity. These are resource quotas without monetary currency; sequence scoring calls differ from predicted tokens.

The fetch child resolves public addresses, pins a checked address for the socket, verifies the original TLS hostname, refuses embedded credentials, redirects, non-200 responses, compressed bodies and unsupported media, and does not execute page scripts. Limits are 1 MiB per page, 8 seconds per page, a 20-second parent deadline and 2 MiB of child output. DNS and a blocked child are also bounded by the parent deadline. At most eight fetch steps are allowed per session. API receipts preserve actual URLs, retrieval timestamps, status, byte/text hashes, elapsed times and configured

The campaign budget ceiling records configuration intent. Manual review does not reserve executor spend; automated execution must integrate real budget policy reservations before it is exposed as an actionable stage.

Closing the reviewed batch publishes a new immutable prepared dataset, with the original source group and feedback provenance. Its training text contains the original prompt and approved correction; the failed prediction remains in review history and does not enter the training text. Existing Training handoffs can consume the resulting revision. This ticket does not automatically launch training, replace a model, claim improvement or enable a release.

Repeat the same tenant request UUID and parameters after an uncertain HTTP result. The response reflects the durable allocation, including provider rejection or uncertainty; HTTP 201 does not imply provider readiness. Conflicting parameters are refused. Lifetime is bounded to 60–86400 seconds. No arbitrary image, command, environment variables, provider endpoint, secret name, or Python module is accepted in a request.

Chat lists verified vision bases and successful candidates. Attach a supported image, ask one visual question and generate greedily with native formatting and 1–16 output tokens within the 128-token context. Each question uses the attached image; earlier turns are retained for display, while generation receives the current question. System prompts, template overrides, image comparisons and external image providers are not supported. Current processor, image, model and project access are checked before output and replay. Switching images after a saved response requires a new conversation. Saved conversations retain an artifact reference, never raw image bytes in browser

Lease expiry fences the old attempt and resumes the last committed stage. A committed rollout is restored instead of resampled. Cancellation kills and waits for an active independent scorer. Divergence stops preserve a measured aborted update and publish no candidate. Partial failures leave existing model revisions untouched.

train.text: Hardware detection, installed runtime compatibility, actual operation execution and model quality are separate facts. The new read-only support report checks the exact installed text profile before any model/job is created. Existing load and training preflight paths remain authoritative for actual inputs, current memory, device admission, worker capacity and budgets. A visible graphics adapter or a successful primitive diagnostic never qualifies a model or a release.

This accounting slice adds pinned prices and append-only monetary corrections to the existing quantity ledger. It does not implement provider collectors, automatic reservation settlement, hierarchical budget limits, or in-flight budget stop enforcement.

The alignment workspace supports real DPO updates on the operator-registered plain SmolLM2-135M base. It trains rank-eight q/v LoRA adapters on Apple MPS using FP32, a frozen independent reference model and response-only sequence log probabilities. The earlier [CPU character alignment](cpu-character-alignment.md) remains a separate synchronous runtime. ORPO and KTO are unavailable.

TASK-76 qualifies local inference on the Apple M5 Pro under the current pinned optional inference dependencies. It does not qualify training, other GPU vendors, every architecture, domain quality or production deployment. [Recorded execution and limits](verification/task76-apple-inference-2026-10-23/report.md).

Formal campaigns reuse actual completed local Chat comparisons. Informal arena votes and imported response text are not independent preference labels. This path creates one frozen batch per campaign, with randomized A/B presentation and separate reviewer assignments. Closing that batch completes the formal campaign even if the legacy maximum-cycle cap is larger.

TASK-75, 23 October 2026. Nir selected **prepare a history-rewrite plan**. This document is that plan; execution, force-pushing, changing branch protection and contacting collaborators remain pending approval. Ordinary implementation PRs may continue merging into main meanwhile. Schedule the rewrite after those PRs land so the plan uses fresh ref IDs.
Context Lab uses the selected qualified CPU reference model's verified tokenizer and role-lines template to count the **complete serialized input**. A successful pinned compilation enforces:

Continued pretraining updates the pinned pretrained SmolLM2-135M transformer using causal next-token loss on plain text. Initialization uses the verified pretrained weights, not random weights. This bounded CPU implementation adds reproducible source mixtures, inherited protected splits, actual loss/token/throughput measurements, durable optimizer and data-cursor recovery, and independently loadable candidate exports. Hardware and customer-quality qualification remain separate.

The [project README](../../README.md) has the quickstart and capability overview. This guide keeps the detailed runtime scope, UI verification procedures and integration-test coverage available alongside the [worker and artifact contracts](worker-operations.md).

ModelAnvil can fine-tune the fixed local Apache-2.0 MiniLM encoder on a committed, project-owned triplet manifest, export independently loadable Safetensors, serve the candidate through the existing authenticated embedding endpoint and build a new native vector index. Training is a **trusted operator command**, separate from the HTTP service and the inference/index worker. This release does not add a browser training form, GPU training, arbitrary embedding architectures, hosted inference or automatic quality-based promotion.

Retrieval can now turn an existing frozen MiniLM token index into a separate, worker-built pgvector revision. The source index and old chunk memberships remain available. The fixed baseline supports inference and indexing; [bounded operator CPU fine-tuning](embedding-fine-tuning.md) produces separately pinned candidate spaces and independently loadable exports. Customer quality qualification remains separate.

The RAG workspace can run one local CPU text model against the same question with no evidence, retrieved evidence, or 1–5 human-selected chunks from the current frozen index. This is actual greedy model inference through the shared Safetensors runtime. Retrieval traces and retrieval-only comparisons retain their existing, separate semantics.

The guided Training screen lets a new account fine-tune an instruction-tuned SmolLM2 model on its own text examples using compute managed by the local ModelAnvil installation. Users do not register tokenizers, manifests, workers or allowances, and do not run server commands.
ModelAnvil now acquires immutable model snapshots, runs local text inference and streams actual responses in Chat. These capabilities are independently implemented in ModelAnvil.

Document workers now persist each completed OCR page before acknowledging permission to process the next page. A failed attempt exposes saved page numbers and total page count in the specialist job status. Retry verifies artifact checksums, frozen input identity, page raster, dimensions, rasterization settings and runtime versions before reusing a page. Layout and recognition execute only for missing pages. Completed-page token usage is aggregated once; started attempts consume the existing currency-free attempt quota. Cancellation, stale fencing and metadata-only egress prohibit checkpoints and publication. No partial document is published.

The supported installation path is the provisioned Linux arm64 Docker package in [deploy/selfhost](../../deploy/selfhost/README.md). One controller installs the private workspace, migrates its database, starts its CPU worker, checks HTTPS readiness and manages paired backup/restore, upgrade and data-retaining uninstall. Installation consumes verified local images rather than assembling development services or downloading dependencies. Initial identity is private and the initial workspace contains no models or manufactured training evidence.

The Overview checklist reads project-scoped saved records. Dataset readiness requires a published nonempty revision with a manifest digest and artifact. A model must have recorded weight artifacts and a registered nonempty tokenizer. An active pool needs an available worker with slots, a matching enabled training runner contract, sufficient declared memory and a compatible model architecture. A budget must be enabled, positive, denominated in training steps and have no currency.

Knowledge-base import now uses a bundled, immutable MiniLM WordPiece tokenizer. The UI and API accept chunk size and maximum overlap in **content tokens**. Defaults are 254 and 32; sizes range from 16 to 4096, and overlap cannot exceed half the size. Chunk text and spans preserve the exact original Unicode source. Paragraph/sentence boundaries are preferred without breaking the token bound; actual overlap can be smaller than requested and is recorded per chunk. Padding, truncation and added special tokens are disabled.

Chat → Tools runs the exact provisioned Qwen3-0.6B snapshot on one CPU worker. The model generates native tool calls, receives actual results and generates a continuation. It does not infer permission from prompts or MCP annotations. Model quality, customer integrations and production qualification remain separate gates.

Open Releases → New candidate release after an actual CPU worker training run and its complete held-out evaluation. Choose the exact candidate/evaluation, quality threshold and recorded license evidence. The review freezes measured results and all required criteria. Failing quality or license criteria stay visible and do not qualify a release. Downloading a failing candidate for inspection preserves those failures in the archive.

These are the current executor, credential and transfer contracts. For local setup and project scope, start with the [project README](../../README.md). Run worker code only in an environment you control.

The application guides teams from a project goal through data, experiments, independent evaluation, and release. Users can enter any qualified workflow directly; they do not have to train a model to build RAG or label data. Every long operation has a durable detail page, current state, ownership, progress, and recovery actions.

The objective follows [DPO equation 7](https://arxiv.org/html/2305.18290v3): negative log-sigmoid of beta times the policy chosen/rejected log-ratio relative to the frozen reference. Response log probabilities are **sums**, including EOS, with the prompt excluded. The worker uses summed cross-entropy because PyTorch's MPS gather backward requires an unsupported nondeterministic scatter operation. Deterministic algorithms remain enabled; CPU fallback is refused.

The backend separates durable control-plane state from large immutable artifacts and isolated execution. PostgreSQL owns identity scopes, version references, workflow state, annotation revisions, qualification decisions, and usage. S3-compatible storage owns payloads and manifests. RabbitMQ wakes eligible workers; it is not the job history database.

Current delivery addendum (23 October 2026): see the [integration inventory](integration-inventory.md), [operation-specific capability baseline](supported-capabilities.md), and dated verification reports. The original review below is historical; current dependency pins require operation-specific GPU qualification; the bounded current MPS evidence is recorded below. Customer discovery remains blocked on customer input.

The separate [Apple GPU DPO profile](apple-dpo.md) uses the plain pinned SmolLM2-135M base, durable worker jobs and independent preference/regression gates. Its worker pool and third protected artifact are not required for these CPU character recipes.

Adapter-only ZIPs exclude base weights and include tokenizer/configuration. The adapter's base reference points to the exact public source/revision; exported checksums identify the rewritten configuration separately from the original checkpoint references. Provision the verified base before loading the adapter offline. ZIPs include the source license. Optimizer state stays in checkpoints.

Design ModelAnvil as a focused technical workspace where teams can inspect data, review model suggestions, run experiments, and make evidence-based release decisions. The interface must remain approachable for annotators and data engineers while giving researchers access to exact configuration and lineage. The primary design outcome is a coherent workflow across these roles.

The [Runpod and custom plugin guide](runpod-and-custom-plugins.md) describes the implemented control API and trusted task execution. The [provider TODO](provider-integration-todo.md) tracks the remaining integrations and qualification work.

The shipped training, evaluation and chat runtimes process content on the configured execution host. Optional external chat is disabled by default and requires both a scoped operator target/credential and explicit administrator approval in Privacy settings. Chat shows the selected destination before sending conversation content. External model judges, synthetic dataset generation, analytics and support uploads are unavailable. This policy controls the shipped acquisition transports; it is not an operating-system firewall or a sandbox for arbitrary trusted Python plugins. Remote databases, brokers, artifact stores and registered workers still require the operator's separate deployment and residency controls.

This document records what is in the tree and splits the remaining work into ANVIL-024, ANVIL-025, ANVIL-026, ANVIL-027, and ANVIL-028. Each child is limited to the files and commands listed under it. That limit is what keeps the child inside two days. This pull request does not add the version file, the install script, the drills, the customer page, or a published tag.

These counts describe the loaded inventory page. They do not qualify bytes, current runtime packages, live device capacity or remaining budget; training preflight verifies those before admission. Partial read failures remain visible, including when the checklist is minimized, with a retry action. Scope/connection changes clear counts and obsolete responses cannot restore previous scope records. Refresh reloads inventory; only the expanded/minimized preference is stored locally.

CSV requires unique nonempty headers and consistent record widths. JSON requires an array of objects with unique keys and finite values. Select a nonempty string text field and optionally a nonempty string source-group field. Without a group mapping, the whole file stays in one protected split group. This avoids splitting related paragraphs or records across training and held-out data; multiple source groups are needed to populate multiple splits. Text is preserved exactly, including Unicode, quoting and line breaks. Empty text or invalid mappings refuse publication.

We will build a multi-organization model development platform with versioned data and model workflows, durable compute orchestration, and independent release evidence. This document specifies the engineering behavior needed to implement the PRD. Requirements use MUST for release obligations and SHOULD for recommended implementation choices. Proposed numeric targets remain subject to qualification under the PRD.

The authoritative requirements remain in [technical requirements](technical-requirements.md) and [implementation plan](implementation-plan.md), especially scoped artifact access in WP-03 and the current-access gateway in WP-04. This hook authorizes **control-plane-to-worker inputs**, not worker output publication.

This describes the current worker API and standalone HTTP agent. The authoritative platform scope remains in [technical requirements](technical-requirements.md), especially TECH-029 and the job/storage contracts. This slice does not satisfy their complete hybrid or artifact-egress acceptance criteria.

This pack turns the product scope into engineering contracts, user journeys, interface direction, a relational data model, and a dependency-based delivery plan. It is ready for architecture review and issue breakdown. It does not establish an implemented or qualified integration, a delivery date, or an approved budget.

Run with the worker's Python environment. Install a compatible, pinned PyTorch build and vendor driver following the [official installation instructions](https://pytorch.org/get-started/locally/). PyTorch is optional and is not added to the control-plane requirements. Missing or broken runtimes return unavailable backends with corrective actions. Inventory can initialize a device runtime to enumerate properties but does not allocate model weights, training tensors or jobs. Selection errors return JSON and exit 2; inventory without a selection exits 0 even when every backend is unavailable.

The general Safetensors bounds remain 300 million parameters and 1 GiB of stored weights. The existing guided large profile has separate bounds and earlier evidence. Eligibility permits an actual load attempt; it does not establish successful loading or broad model support. GGUF GPU/Vulkan, CUDA, ROCm and XPU inference are outside this qualification.

This document defines relational entities, field types, relationships, lifecycle rules, and critical transactions. It is the input to Django models and reviewed migrations, not an already applied migration. JSON schemas in this pack define two initial interchange contracts; task payloads and individual adapter protocols need further versioned contracts during implementation.

Generate and save local response pairs in Chat with matched prompt/decoding settings. The server verifies their actual completed inference records, input/output digests, distinct response text and current model/tokenizer manifest identity. External-provider pairs are excluded. The selecting user has already seen the model set and cannot be an assigned blind reviewer.

For current operation-specific support, artifact references and remaining qualification, see the [updated capability baseline](supported-capabilities.md). This audit retains its original scenario-by-scenario review scope.

Model/tokenizer artifact hashes, tokenizer identity, runtime contract and template pins are rechecked before compilation. The runtime limit comes from the qualified model bundle (up to 64 tokens in this bounded CPU profile). Output reserve is 1–32 tokens for these runtimes. Even an empty template plus reserve must fit when saving a pinned recipe. Compilation never executes a model; measured paired experiments separately verify actual inference usage against the compiled count.

Prepare and publish each original plain-text source through the existing dataset preparation flow. In Training, open **Advanced settings**, choose **CPU/GPU continued pretraining**, then **Build a weighted text corpus**. Select one to four original source revisions, relative weights, a training-row count, a selection seed and a new corpus name. **Publish and select corpus** saves a new immutable revision and selects it for training. It defaults the training plan to three explicit updates. Choose the matching pinned base, tokenizer, dedicated worker, runtime manifest and step budget; review preflight before launching.

This brief specifies product design direction and handoff requirements. It is not a completed screen design or a usability-validated brand system. The initial ICP remains AI product companies with dedicated ML teams; enterprise platform and research teams are secondary audiences to validate through pilots.

ModelAnvil can connect to rented GPU capacity, managed GPU jobs, hosted model endpoints, and external artifact stores. Start with a customer-owned provider account, one Runpod compute integration, one hosted inference integration, and a custom plugin contract. Add more providers after the first integration proves worker bootstrap, artifact transfer, cancellation, cleanup, and cost reconciliation.

Install the base and optional CPU embedding requirements with the pinned Python 3.12 environment. The same Torch/Transformers packages serve the decoder. Bootstrap is an explicit operator network action; generation requests never download weights.

Implement shared platform contracts first, prove both scratch and fine-tuning paths early, then add collaboration/alignment, RAG/context workbenches, and release/operations qualification. The first complete release must satisfy all R1 requirements and all 17 PRD acceptance scenarios. Development increments below are not independent claims of complete product support.

Infrastructure and budgets link to their inspection screens; operator registration is still required for missing workers/policies. Metadata-only registration cannot make a model ready.

DOCX extracts main-body paragraphs, including paragraphs in tables, preserving tabs and explicit breaks. It excludes headers, footnotes, images, embedded objects and rendered page layout. It never follows document relationships or extracts ZIP files to disk. Duplicate archive entries, encrypted main XML, archives over 1000 entries or 16 MiB uncompressed, non-UTF-8 XML, DTD/entity declarations and malformed documents are refused.

ModelAnvil executes real local data preparation, bounded training, inference, evaluation, export and CPU serving. Support is specific to each operation, recipe and tested environment. The archived guided Apple GPU journey and the current CPU evaluation/release journey have different support envelopes. Archived GPU reports predate the current dependency upgrade. New [bounded MPS FP32 full-SFT/LoRA evidence](verification/task40-current-mps-2026-10-23/report.md) records current pins for that exact operation/device envelope; other GPU profiles require separate qualification. Supply a stable source identifier to reuse an unchanged document revision. Changed content creates a source revision; changed chunk settings create another immutable chunk set on the same source revision. Older indexes preserve their original membership and continue respecting current access, revocation and tombstones. Reindexing includes all current source documents under the selected recipe. Active text is bounded to 2 MB per local index and output to 10,000 chunks; the operation is atomic. Old character-based indexes retain their recorded recipe.

Current checks revalidate evidence and access. The UI reports frozen and checked times; missing or changed evidence makes the review stale, hides its frozen case content and blocks export/serving. Restore authorized inputs, rerun an outdated evaluation and create a fresh review. Older reviews without immutable consumer/evidence pins also require a fresh review. A passing frozen review, endpoint pointer and old startup record alone do not establish current live serving readiness.

The persistent shell contains installation, organization, and project selectors; a global search limited to authorized resources; a job activity drawer; and account/settings access. Project navigation is Overview, Data, Annotation, Models, Training, Evaluation, RAG, Context Lab, Releases, and Infrastructure. Per-position results include total/correct counts, per-repeat accuracy, population standard deviation and the number of unique raw outputs for each case. Greedy repeats can have zero variation; that observation is reported. A descriptive middle dip is present only when measured middle accuracy is below the mean edge accuracy. The report makes no statistical significance or general long-context claim.

Provider capabilities below come from official documentation. Integration priorities and contracts are proposed engineering choices. None of these listings establishes a working or qualified ModelAnvil integration. Prices, regional capacity, quotas, and supported models must be checked for the customer's account when selecting a workload.

The advanced base-model profile retains its role-prefix format. The candidate exports its matching chat template so downloaded files and in-app chat use the same formatting. Plain text learns all text tokens.
